legos.why: Rule: every practice phrase under a LEGO contains the whole LEGO, in exactly the taught form. Two rows use the noun الاختبار / اختبار ("testing"), never taught, under the verb LEGO "test | تختبر". Both are reworded to the verb. The builder wants 3 build rows that put the LEGO inside a phrase and 5 use rows; this basket was short once its broken rows were fixed, so rows are added from words already taught.

Rule: every practice phrase under a LEGO contains the whole LEGO, in exactly the taught form. Two rows say علشان كده ("that is why"), the seed's OLD wording, under the LEGO "the reason | السبب". The row is the seed sentence, still in the wording the seed had before it was changed; it is brought to the seed's live words, English unchanged. U01 becomes the seed's opening "that is why | ده السبب ليه". Their English is the seed's own ("that is why"), which is why it does not literally say "the reason".

U05: that is why he didn't know the answer
ده السبب ليه ماكانش عارف الإجابة

HOLD: this LEGO "same | نفس" is an exact copy, both sides, of the earlier LEGO S0062L03, so it belongs to the duplicate-LEGO plan: a LEGO is introduced once and the later copy becomes not-new, whose basket is never played. The one bad row here (U05 "same as before | زي قبل كده", which has no نفس) goes with that decision; if the LEGO is kept as new instead, U05 is reworded to hold نفس.
